title: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure initiation

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to modify an existing PDU session. The UE creates a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message and starts timer T3581.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate PDU session modification. Contains various IEs depending on modification type.

entities.name: PTI
entities.description: Procedure Transaction Identity IE allocated by UE for the modification procedure.

entities.name: Requested QoS rules
entities.description: IE containing QoS rules requested by UE for specific QoS handling. Includes packet filters and rule operation codes.

entities.name: Requested QoS flow descriptions
entities.description: IE containing QoS flow descriptions with specific QoS parameters requested by UE.

entities.name: Requested MBS container
entities.description: IE used to join or leave MBS multicast sessions. Contains MBS operation type and session information.

entities.name: 5GSM capability
entities.description: IE containing UE capabilities including RQoS bit, MH6-PDU bit, ATSSS-ST bits, and APMQF bit.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: IE used for various purposes including 3GPP PS data off status, ECS configuration, DNS server requests, EAS rediscovery, and EDC support.

entities.name: Always-on PDU session requested
entities.description: IE used to request that a PDU session be always-on in 5GS.

entities.name: Service-level-AA container
entities.description: IE used for C2 communication containing service-level device ID and service-level-AA payload.

entities.name: T3581
entities.description: Timer started by UE when sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST. Stopped upon receiving response.

entities.name: Emergency PDU session restriction
entities.description: UE shall not perform modification procedure for emergency PDU sessions except for specific cases.

entities.name: LADN outside service area restriction
entities.description: UE shall not perform modification procedure for LADN PDU sessions when outside service area except for 3GPP PS data off status change.

relations.description: Procedure involves sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message
Message contains PTI IE with allocated procedure transaction identity
Message may contain Requested QoS rules IE for QoS handling requests
Message may contain Requested QoS flow descriptions IE for QoS parameters
Message may contain Requested MBS container IE for MBS session operations
Message contains 5GSM capability IE with various capability indicators
Message may contain Extended protocol configuration options IE for various purposes
Message may contain Always-on PDU session requested IE
Message may contain Service-level-AA container IE for C2 communication
Procedure starts timer T3581 when sending modification request
Procedure execution is restricted for emergency PDU sessions
Procedure execution is restricted for LADN PDU sessions outside service area
